name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Hand-ported (no Radix) vertically-stacked expand/collapse panels. Compound Accordion + Accordion.Item API; single (default, one-open) or multi (independent) expand; controlled value/values + onValueChange with uncontrolled defaultValue/defaultValues; heading-level 2|3|4. Real <button> trigger with aria-expanded/aria-controls, role=region panel with aria-labelledby; roving ArrowUp/ArrowDown + Home/End keyboard nav skipping disabled; CSS-only max-height open animation driven by .hbd-accordion__item--open. onOpen/onClose carry { index, title }.
